item.title: Earthquake today: Magnitude 7 quake strikes Tibet in China, epicentre near Nagqu
item.description: The epicenter was in northern Tibet's Nagqu at a depth of 10 km. The area has an average elevation of around 4,864 metres. The epicentre was about 400 km from the Tibetan capital, Lhasa.
item.dc:creator: Prabhakar Jha
item.content:encoded: An earthquake of magnitude 7 struck Tibet region of China at around 10.33 pm local time on Thursday, Reuters reported citing the China Earthquake Networks Center (CENC).The epicenter was in northern Tibet's Nagqu at a depth of 10 km. The area has an average elevation of around 4,864 metres. The epicentre was about 400 km from the Tibetan capital, Lhasa.More details awaited
item.wire:evidence: reporting reference, not an exact wire credit: Reuters reported
